entities.summary: Valery Konstantinovich Lvov was a Soviet-Russian boxer. He competed at the 1975 European Amateur Boxing Championships, winning the silver medal in the lightweight event. He also competed at the 1978 World Amateur Boxing Championships, winning the gold medal in the light welterweight event.
